cases._section: === E. ICU Network API (the large, under-tested doc) ===
cases.q: what port does the ICU device HTTPS API use
cases.reference: ICU device HTTPS API port is 44345 (HTTPS only). Example base URL https://192.168.137.8:44345. [PROBE] borderline retrieval — near the gate.

cases.q: is the ICU Network API available over plain HTTP
cases.reference: No — the API is available via HTTPS only.

cases.q: how does the ICU Network API authenticate users
cases.reference: It uses a token request system: the user sends a token request, then includes that token string in subsequent request headers.

cases.q: what HTTP status code does the ICU API return for an unauthorised request
cases.reference: 401 Unauthorised. (The API uses standard HTTP codes: 200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorised, 404 Not Found, 500 Internal Server Error.)
